newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee market quiet after roaster buying.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee market quiet after roaster buying.

text.p: Coffee roasters were sidelined in the Bremen market after carrying out price fixations earlier in the week, traders said.
Consumers were seeking a break in a market featuring high arabica futures and differentials although London robustas turned lower over the last two days.
East Africans, Brazils and Colombians were mostly neglected because they were too expensive and Colombian offers for March/April were scarce.
Uncertainty surrounded talk in Brazil an eagerly awaited forecast for Brazil's 1997/98 crop was larger than assumed.
